raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "8.0.0"

  # dependencies
  lal_version: 8.0.0
  lalframe_version: 3.1.0
  lalinference_version: 5.0.0
  lalsimulation_version: 7.0.0

  # LAL requires downstream packages to be built with the same version of SWIG,
  # so we need to pin it here
  swig_version: 4.4.1

recipe:
  name: lalpulsar-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lalpulsar-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: 4b5f7d219d59b8e7695aa0c3cc4c59a660eb539a755f49f62afc2ffb4b0bb383

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lalpulsar-c-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - cfitsio
        - fftw
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - liblalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
        - liblalinference >=${{ lalinference_version }}
        - liblalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
          else: llvm-openmp
        # extras for `make check` (when not cross-compiling)
        - if: build_platform == target_platform
          then:
            - bc
            - lalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: lalpulsar-data
    inherit:
      from: lalpulsar-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - etc/conda/activate.d/activate-lalpulsar-data.*
        - etc/conda/deactivate.d/deactivate-lalpulsar-data.*
        - share/lalpulsar/
    requirements:
      run_constraints:
        - liblalpulsar >=4.0.0
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/lalpulsar/sun00-40-DE405.dat.gz
      - script:
          # check that the activate script sets the data path
          - test -f ${LALPULSAR_DATADIR}/sun00-40-DE405.dat.gz
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library data files
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the data files needed to run various applications
        and routines that use the LAL Pulsar library.

  - package:
      name: liblalpulsar
    inherit: lalpulsar-c-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblalpulsar*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalpulsar*.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("lalpulsar-data", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalpulsar", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        - lalpulsar >=3.0.0
        - python-lalpulsar >=3.0.0
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalpulsar
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalpulsar
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL Pulsar library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalpulsar
    inherit:
      from: lalpulsar-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalpulsar so that we ensure a unique
        # python-lalpulsar build string for each unique liblalpulsar build
        use_keys:
          - cfitsio
          - fftw
          - gsl
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalpulsar", exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalpulsar", exact=True) }}
        - astropy-base
        - numpy
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - python-lalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
        - python-lalinference >=${{ lalinference_version }}
        - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalpulsar
            - lalpulsar.NstarTools
            - lalpulsar.PulsarParametersWrapper
            - lalpulsar.knope_utils
            - lalpulsar.pulsarhtmlutils
            - lalpulsar.pulsarpputils
            - lalpulsar.simulateCW
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
            - lib/*.dat.gz
        script:
          - LAL_TEST_PKGDATADIR="./lib" python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LALPulsar C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalpulsar` package.

  - package:
      name: lalpulsar
    inherit:
      from: lalpulsar-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lalpulsar-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: build-bin
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblalpulsar so that we ensure a unique
        # lalpulsar build string for each unique liblalpulsar build
        use_keys:
          - cfitsio
          - fftw
          - gsl
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - rsync
        - sed
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalpulsar", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalpulsar", exact=True) }}
        - cfitsio
        - fftw
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - liblalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
        - liblalinference >=${{ lalinference_version }}
        - liblalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        # needed by ./configure
        - numpy
        - python
        # extras for `make check` (when not cross-compiling)
        - if: build_platform == target_platform
          then:
            - astropy-base
            - bc
            - h5py
            - jplephem
            - lalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
            - lalinference >=${{ lalinference_version }}
            - pytest
            - scipy
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalpulsar", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalpulsar", exact=True) }}
        - astropy-base
        - jplephem
        - lalinference >=${{ lalinference_version }}
        - numpy
        - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalpulsar
          pip_check: false
      - script:
          # assert that the manuals don't just contain errors
          - grep -q ModuleNotFoundError ${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/lalpulsar_*.1 && exit 1
          # check executables
          - lalpulsar_create_time_correction_ephemeris --help
          - lalpulsar_fits_header_getval --help
          - lalpulsar_fits_header_list --help
          - lalpulsar_fits_overview --help
          - lalpulsar_fits_table_list --help
          - lalpulsar_heterodyne --help
          - lalpulsar_knope --help
          - lalpulsar_knope_collate_results --help
          # lalpulsar_knope_result_page --help  <- needs scotchcorner
          - lalpulsar_frequency_evolution --help
          - lalpulsar_parameter_estimation_nested --help
          - lalpulsar_splitSFTs --help
          - test "$(lalpulsar_ssbtodetector --gps 1000000000 --ra 0 --dec 0 --telescope JBO)" == "999999506.306100250"
          - lalpulsar_version --verbose
          # the user environment script rewrites PATH, so check that it still works
          - bash -c '. "${PREFIX}/etc/lalpulsar-user-env.sh" && lalpulsar_version'
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Pulsar Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the runtime tools.
